apps/api/src/db/entity-feature-gate-meta.reason: Row policy definition: part of the gate itself, not a consumer of it.

apps/api/src/db/entity-feature-policies..reason: Row policy definition: part of the gate itself, not a consumer of it.

apps/api/src/db/rls.ts::reads-authorizat.reason: Declares the view and the workspace row policies that consult it.

apps/api/src/handlers/entities/join-foli.reason: Rechecks the joining member's matter membership inside a transaction that pins the matter, where the view would admit the pinned id; moves to the owner module once it offers a membership-only check.

apps/api/src/lib/auth.ts::derives-matter.reason: Route authorization and realtime audience resolution run on the owner connection before a scoped transaction exists; the proved id is pinned and every later read passes the row policies. Moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/db/member-access-hold.t.reason: Share-locks the membership rows an operation depends on and reports which requested matters stay reachable, so a concurrent removal serializes with the operation; reads the rows directly so pinned matters do not count. Moves to the owner module once it offers a membership-only check.

apps/api/src/lib/delete-account.ts::owne.reason: Account deletion reassigns work among the remaining members of the departing user's matters; a system operation, not a reader's allowlist.

apps/api/src/lib/desktop-edit-handoffs.t.reason: Re-evaluates a desktop handoff credential against live membership before pinning its one matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/desktop-edit-sessions.t.reason: Re-evaluates a desktop edit session credential against live membership before pinning its one matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/files/pdf-signing/sessi.reason: Re-evaluates a signing session credential against live membership before pinning its one matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/folio-collab-rooms.ts::.reason: Re-evaluates a collaboration room token against live membership before pinning its one matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/lists/verification/acce.reason: Background list verification rechecks the requesting member before pinning its one matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a per-member check.

apps/api/src/lib/search/index-global.ts:.reason: The owner connection only maintains search projections; reads take the caller's scoped transaction and filter by the ids the request resolved through the owner module.

apps/api/src/lib/time-entry-timer-access.reason: Rechecks the timer owner's matter access under a matter lock when a timer starts, changes or finalizes; moves to the owner module once it offers a membership-only check.

apps/api/src/lib/workspace-deletion.ts::.reason: Authorizes matter deletion for the acting member inside a transaction that pins the matter; moves to the owner module once it offers a membership-only check.
